entries.title: codex executor rejects a writable root that contains a symlink component
entries.cause: A codex consumer lists ~/.sirsi/relay (a symlink to /var/sirsipantheon/relay) in writable_roots or --add-dir; every sandboxed command fails, dispatches make no progress and the lane quarantines.

fix.text: List only the real path /var/sirsipantheon/relay in the consumer command; restart the lane loop.

entries.title: task complete/release refused: caller's session does not own this lease
entries.signature: caller's session does not own this lease
entries.cause: Consumers without SIRSI_AGENT_ID authenticated as the hostname and shared one session cache file, so the session that claimed was not the one that completed.

fix.text: Upgrade to 0.24.66 or later (per-thread session cache; dispatch-contract agent id). Meanwhile set SIRSI_AGENT_ID and SIRSI_THREAD_ID on the command line.

entries.title: thread registration fails: fork/exec /bin/ps operation not permitted
entries.cause: A sandboxed worker cannot run ps, so the durable anchor cannot be resolved and registration fails.

fix.text: Upgrade to 0.24.67 or later (sysctl lookup, then immediate-parent fallback).

entries.title: relay: no response within 30s on ListAll / GetState / ListTasks
entries.cause: router ledger and router status read all 13,000+ items (6-20 s per call on the service); concurrent callers exceeded the spool wait.

fix.text: Upgrade to 0.24.68 or later (ListActive/CountClosed). Do not blind-retry a mutation: re-query first.

entries.title: identity is not fully declared / lane flips to WATCH_ONLY after a registry edit
entries.cause: agents.json was read from a shared working tree, so another session's branch or uncommitted edit changed who the lanes are.

fix.text: Run `sirsi router registry sync` to pin the host to origin/main; change the registry only through a PR.

entries.title: task claim refused: no claimable task in the ledger
entries.signature: no claimable task in the ledger
entries.cause: The row is blocked_by a dependency or free-text reason, holds a live lease, or is at the retry ceiling.

fix.text: Run `sirsi router task why <agent> <task-id>`; clear blocked_by with `task update --blocked-by ""` when true; `task reset-attempts` only after the cause is fixed.

entries.title: golangci-lint refuses to start because another lint is already running on this host
entries.cause: Two Ma'at pre-push gates (or a gate and a manual lint) ran at once on one Mac. golangci-lint allows one instance per host, so the second run fails even though its code is clean. Several agents push from the same machine.

fix.text: Nothing is wrong with your code. The gate now queues behind any other gate on this host (.githooks/gate-lock.sh); wait for the other push to finish and re-run. Do not run two lints at once, and do not bypass the gate with --no-verify.

entries.title: the sender-flood test fails at the top of the hour with a doubled item count
entries.cause: The send quota window is one wall-clock hour. A test that ran its 500-send loop on the real clock across the hour boundary got two budgets, so it saw twice the expected items and failed the gate (v0.24.95 release, 06:00 UTC).

fix.text: Re-run: it is the clock, not your change. The test now pins the store clock. Any new test that counts items inside a quota or time-bucket window must inject the clock and never read wall time.
